mapping.summary: Cross-department stage and task workflows in BC, e.g. order-to-shipment, onboarding, approvals.
claims: Process templates made of stages owned by departments, each with tasks
Department board with filters for rush, on hold, overdue and behind target
Tasks with owners, co-workers and cross-stage predecessors, planned in working days
Sample templates for sales project, production order, airport pickup and onboarding
Links production orders to sales orders and advances on release, finish and posting
Optional gates warn about or block actions until stages are done
Per-stage service targets in working days with alerts and bottleneck dashboard
Gantt timeline and lateness breakdown report
Notifications, @mentions, email digests, task attachments and history
Users who only release or post documents need no licence
